source.title: Forebears Niger forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables support representative Nigerien names. This is not an official civil registry export; gender grouping remains a review seed.

source.title: ITU Niger national numbering plan update

phones.notes: ITU/ARCEP confirms country code +227, eight-digit mobile-network services and a public 74 mobile NDC. Broad 8/9 generation was removed until additional active mobile NDCs are directly sourced.

locations.notes: UPU example confirms Niger address ordering and a four-digit Niamey postcode sample. Region/city/street values remain representative review data; postalPrefixes are generator prefixes, not complete postcodes.

national_identity_card_number.label: National Biometric Identity Card Number

source.title: Niger government launch of AES biometric national identity card

national_identity_card_number.notes: Official government material confirms the biometric national identity card program, but no public number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was confirmed. CNI is a generator marker, not a claimed literal prefix.

source.title: Niger government AES biometric passport enrolment notice

passport.notes: Official government material confirms biometric passport enrolment context. No public passport-number grammar was confirmed, so generation remains template-only synthetic.
